lines.en: I fly slowly on wide wings.

lines.zh: 翅膀上的纹像两只眼睛
lines.en: The patterns on my wings look like eyes.
At night I thread between the trees.
My wingbeats are very soft.

lines.zh: 棕红的翅在月光下发暗
lines.en: My russet wings darken in moonlight.
I bank around a tree trunk.
Wide wings make my turns clumsy.
I head for the white flowers.
My shadow sways on the forest floor.
I keep low, never high.
One beat, then a long glide.
I hunt the scent of flowers.
My wingtip brushes a leaf.
These wings will last only days.
So I don't fly slowly.
I settle on a flower, then rise.

lines.zh: 我停在树干上，摊平翅膀
lines.en: I rest on a trunk with wings flat.
At night the wood is all insects.
My proboscis is coiled away.
My days are numbered.

lines.zh: 翅上的眼纹能吓退小鸟
lines.en: The eye marks scare off small birds.
I wait for white tulips to open.
I'm heavy-bodied with great wings.
Moonlight picks out my wing marks.
Someone below is holding a net.

lines.zh: 我只想要花蜜，别的都不要
lines.en: I want only nectar, nothing else.
I fan my wings twice, slowly.
It's cool in the wood. Good.
My antennae move.

lines.zh: 再过几天，我就飞不动了
lines.en: In a few days I won't be able to fly.
You're holding a net. I can see it.
You want to pin me to paper.
I'm no bird, and shouting won't frighten me.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的帽子飞了一圈。
lines.en: I circle your hat once.

lines.zh: 你身上有花香，也有铁味
lines.en: You smell of flowers, and of iron.
My wing marks are bigger than your face.
If you want me, be quick.

lines.zh: 我落到你够不着的高度
lines.en: I settle above your reach.
Let's both hold still, shall we?
I have only a few nights left.
A corner of my wing is torn.
I come down, tilted.
A layer of wing dust comes off.
I can't fly steady, only glide.
One antenna is bent.

lines.zh: 这一下让我少了一截腿
lines.en: That cost me part of a leg.
I stop on a leaf, unable to draw breath.
My life just got shorter again.
Don't squeeze. The wings will be ruined.
I'd like to fly a little longer.
White tulips. I know them.
Is that one white in your hand?
There's sweetness. I'll come closer.
I don't eat leaves; I drink nectar.
That flower is well placed.
I'll pollinate it in passing.
Hold it higher if you like.
I settle on the petal's edge.
That one's wilted. Any others?
Step back so I can drink in peace.
My wing hits your shoulder.

lines.zh: 翅膀被碰歪了，我歪着飞
lines.en: A knock skews my wings; I fly crooked.
That drove me up into the tree.
I swing around you and land again.
Your net sweeps up from below.
I slip past the net's rim.

lines.zh: 翅粉落了一点在你手上
lines.en: A little wing dust settles on your hand.
Don't swat. Wings shatter.

lines.zh: 我们撞上后，我飞高了些
lines.en: After the bump I fly higher.
Touch me again and I'm gone.
By the white flowers, there'll be company.
My antennae smell far off.
We have only days.
So stop circling. Come here.
Do our wing marks match?
I'll wait for you on the tree.
I'm heavy and can't fly far.

lines.zh: 我们就在这几棵树之间
lines.en: Let's stay among these few trees.
It's cool at night. Come closer.
Next year the wood will have more moths.
I land on flowers. I don't pick things up.
My feet only grip flowers.
With a net about, I can't take anything.

lines.zh: 你放在叶上的东西，我不碰
lines.en: Things on leaves, I don't touch.
All I carry away is pollen.
That's far too heavy for me.
I settle beside it to look.
Nothing here is worth carrying.

lines.zh: 我要的是花蜜，不是这个
lines.en: What I want is nectar, not this.

lines.zh: 我这翅膀一展，比手掌还宽。
lines.en: Spread my wings, and they're wider than a palm.
I have no attack, only wings.
Net's up. I have to go.
I'm looking for a way out.
The trees are thick; turning risks a crash.
You won't catch me at night.
I'll dive low.

lines.zh: 我的翅纹能吓住鸟，吓不住你
lines.en: My eye marks fool birds, not you.
I won't go where you're blocking.
I don't expect to win this.
I just want to last till dawn.
Your net is raised higher than I am.
I circle along the trunk.
Your hand moved first.
I'm hunting a gap.
Only when you step back will I land.
My wings are tiring.
I slip behind the tree.
Don't move, and neither will I.
This night is too short to use.
When the wind comes, I'm gone.
Flying at your net was a mistake.

lines.zh: 翅膀拍在你脸上，只扬起粉。
lines.en: My wing brushes your face and only raises dust.

lines.zh: 这一下没伤到你，我知道
lines.en: That couldn't hurt you. I know.
A net cord trips my flight.
Wing dust scatters over your hand.
I struggle upward.
Really, this is me fleeing.
Hitting you was a miscalculation.
My wing membrane is fragile.
Don't squeeze. I won't resist.

lines.zh: 我从茧里钻出来，翅还湿
lines.en: I came out of the cocoon, wings still damp.
A great moth joins the forest.
My wings unfold slowly, huge.
Night is young. I still have time.
I need white tulips.
Moonlight lights up my wing marks.
I dried a long while on the trunk.
These are the only wings I'll get.
There are flowers in this wood.
I lift off and begin searching.
My wings curl at the first touch of fire.
I land on leaf litter, one wing bent.

lines.zh: 翅吸了水，我飞不起来了
lines.en: My wings soak and I can't lift off.

lines.zh: 我这身花纹，比手掌还大。
lines.en: My wing patterns are wider than your palm.

lines.zh: 箭穿了我的翅，留下个洞
lines.en: An arrow punches a hole through my wing.

lines.zh: 这光照得我翅纹都发白
lines.en: That light bleaches my wing marks.
No nectar, and my flight is fading.
A flash of lightning and I go numb.

lines.zh: 没有树也没有风，我下坠
lines.en: No trees, no wind. I drop.
